name: DataSubjectRequestManager
tagline: Every access, erasure and opt-out request verified, searched, reviewed and answered before the statutory clock runs out.
description: A complete data subject request (DSAR) app for privacy and legal teams: intake with duplicate checks, identity verification that starts the clock, statutory deadlines per privacy law with validated extensions, system search tasks with records found, exemptions and redaction rationale, DPO approval rules, a generated response letter and on-time reporting – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Statutory clocks per privacy law (GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PDPA, LGPD, PIPEDA – configurable)
Clock starts at identity verification or receipt
Extensions validated against the legal maximum
System search tasks with owners, due dates and records found
Exemptions, redaction rationale and litigation-hold check
DPO approval for refusals and partial responses
Bulk owner and status changes with undo, CSV export
Phone layout with bottom view switcher and case picker
controlType: standard (DataSubjectRequestManager data-set control + DataSubjectRequestManagerPortal field control)
